Southern England and Wales recorded no rainfall in July for the first time since records began. This exceptional period was marked by intense heat and sunshine.

item.title: Three lions die of suspected heatstroke at Tokyo zoo
item.description:

item.title: Notorious feral cat caught after three years in New Zealand
item.description:
A large tabby cat known as 'Nine Lives' has been killed after eluding trappers for three years. The predator was responsible for killing dozens of rare brown teal ducks and various native wildlife.
